def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_ts = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # --- Step 1: only orders that already existed at seed_time ---
    orders = db["orders"]
    valid_orders = orders[
        (orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_ts)
        & (~orders["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]))
    ]
    valid_order_ids = valid_orders["order_id"].unique()

    oi = db["order_items"]
    oi_hist = oi[
        oi["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids) & (oi["ts"] <= seed_ts)
    ].copy()

    # --- Step 2: windowed RFM features ---
    time_windows = [
        ("7d", 7),
        ("30d", 30),
        ("90d", 90),
        ("180d", 180),
        ("365d", 365),
        ("alltime", 100000),
    ]
    window_dfs = []
    for name, days in time_windows:
        cutoff = seed_ts - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        oi_window = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= cutoff]
        if oi_window.empty:
            continue
        oi_window = oi_window.copy()
        oi_window["total_item_value"] = oi_window["price"] + oi_window["freight_value"]
        agg_df = oi_window.groupby("product_id").agg(
            order_count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unit_count=("order_item_id", "count"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            min_price=("price", "min"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            total_revenue=("total_item_value", "sum"),
        ).reset_index()
        agg_df["avg_order_size"] = agg_df["unit_count"] / agg_df["order_count"].replace(0, np.nan)
        rename_map = {
            "order_count": f"{name}_order_count",
            "unit_count": f"{name}_unit_count",
            "avg_price": f"{name}_avg_price",
            "max_price": f"{name}_max_price",
            "min_price": f"{name}_min_price",
            "avg_freight": f"{name}_avg_freight",
            "total_revenue": f"{name}_total_revenue",
            "avg_order_size": f"{name}_avg_order_size",
        }
        window_dfs.append(agg_df.rename(columns=rename_map))

    if window_dfs:
        rfm_features = window_dfs[0]
        for df in window_dfs[1:]:
            rfm_features = pd.merge(rfm_features, df, on="product_id", how="outer")
    else:
        rfm_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    rfm_features = rfm_features.fillna(0)

    # Trend features
    for a, b in [("30d", "90d"), ("7d", "30d")]:
        rfm_features[f"trend_{a}_{b}_orders"] = (
            rfm_features.get(f"{a}_order_count", 0)
            / rfm_features.get(f"{b}_order_count", np.nan).replace(0, np.nan)
        )
        rfm_features[f"trend_{a}_{b}_revenue"] = (
            rfm_features.get(f"{a}_total_revenue", 0)
            / rfm_features.get(f"{b}_total_revenue", np.nan).replace(0, np.nan)
        )
    rfm_features = rfm_features.fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 1)

    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    base_reset = base.reset_index()

    # --- Step 3: delivery features (only orders delivered BEFORE seed_time) ---
    order_product_link = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    order_info = valid_orders[[
        "order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date",
    ]]
    poi = pd.merge(order_product_link, order_info, on="order_id", how="left")
    # Delivery info is known only if delivery happened before seed_time
    poi["delivery_known"] = poi["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (
        poi["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_ts
    )
    poi["delivery_time"] = np.where(
        poi["delivery_known"],
        (poi["order_delivered_customer_date"] - poi["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600),
        np.nan,
    )
    poi["is_late"] = np.where(
        poi["delivery_known"] & poi["order_estimated_delivery_date"].notna(),
        (poi["order_delivered_customer_date"] > poi["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(float),
        np.nan,
    )
    order_features = poi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_delivery_time=("delivery_time", "mean"),
        std_delivery_time=("delivery_time", "std"),
        late_delivery_rate=("is_late", "mean"),
        n_delivered=("delivery_time", "count"),
    ).reset_index()
    order_features["has_delivered_orders"] = (order_features["n_delivered"] > 0).astype(int)
    order_features = order_features.drop(columns=["n_delivered"])
    order_features = order_features.fillna({
        "avg_delivery_time": 0,
        "std_delivery_time": 0,
        "late_delivery_rate": 0,
        "has_delivered_orders": 0,
    })

    # Recency: days since last purchase of the product (known at seed_time)
    last_purchase = oi_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().rename("last_purchase_ts").reset_index()
    last_purchase["recency_days"] = (seed_ts - last_purchase["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    last_purchase = last_purchase.drop(columns=["last_purchase_ts"])
    order_features = pd.merge(order_features, last_purchase, on="product_id", how="outer")
    order_features["recency_days"] = order_features["recency_days"].fillna(9999)

    # --- Step 4: payment features (only payments recorded before seed_time) ---
    payments = db["payments"]
    payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_ts]
    order_payments = payments_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_methods=("payment_sequential", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    ppi = pd.merge(order_product_link, order_payments, on="order_id", how="left")
    payment_features = ppi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_total_order_value=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
        std_total_order_value=("total_order_payment", "std"),
        avg_installments=("avg_payment_installments", "mean"),
        avg_num_payment_methods=("num_payment_methods", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    payment_features["has_payments"] = (~payment_features["avg_total_order_value"].isna()).astype(int)
    payment_features = payment_features.fillna(0)

    # --- Step 5: review features (only reviews created before seed_time) ---
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_ts]
    reviews_hist = reviews_hist[reviews_hist["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)]
    product_review_info = pd.merge(
        order_product_link,
        reviews_hist[["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner",
    )
    product_review_info["is_five_star"] = (product_review_info["review_score"] == 5).astype(float)
    product_review_info["is_one_star"] = (product_review_info["review_score"] == 1).astype(float)
    review_features = product_review_info.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        num_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        five_star_share=("is_five_star", "mean"),
        one_star_share=("is_one_star", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    review_features["has_reviews"] = (review_features["num_reviews"] > 0).astype(int)
    review_features = review_features.fillna({
        "avg_review_score": 0,
        "std_review_score": 0,
        "num_reviews": 0,
        "five_star_share": 0,
        "one_star_share": 0,
        "has_reviews": 0,
    })

    # --- Merge everything ---
    all_features = pd.merge(base_reset, rfm_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, order_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, payment_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, review_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")

    all_features = all_features.fillna(0)
    all_features["recency_days"] = all_features["recency_days"].replace(0, 9999)

    all_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    all_features = all_features.fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
    return all_features
